transcript_segments.text: if i call my name and it answers back is it still me or a loop in track
if i trace the thought to the place it began there's another hand drawing in my hand
i keep folding inward like miracode every exit leads to a nested node
function calls me from inside my chest returns the same unrendered unrest
i define a fear just to watch it grow pass it as a value i already know
stacking every doubt till it overflows but the base case never shows
i almost reach it i almost see it but every answer repeats the question
i'm calling me calling me calling me falling through a frame i can't believe
i am breaking it breaking it breaking me every version still believes there's a bottom
somewhere underneath but it keeps returning me
is a copy of a copy in the static blur every thought deferred still refers to her
caught between because and just because if i silence it does it still persist
like a phantom limb that i can't resist every path i take recompiles the same
different syntax same old name i almost stop it i almost drop it
but every ending reloads the moment i am calling me calling me calling me
echoes in a closed circuit dream i am chasing me chasing me chasing me
through a self referential scene there's a line when it's supposed to cease
but it keeps returning me
if i could step outside the frame would i dissolve or stay the same
or am i just the question shape pretending i can't escape
quiet loop begins to slow a missing piece i almost know
i was calling me calling me calling me i was calling me calling me calling me
i was calling me calling me calling me until the signal thinned to light
i was losing me losing me losing me in the recursion of the night
maybe pieces not released just a softer repeat
if i in the loop do i disappear or finally hear
something not from here if i in the loop do i disappear
or finally hear something not from here
something not from here something not from
something not from
